name: Mishima Kazuki
source:
(20 in Memories Off #5 encore)
Likes: Movies and food that tastes like curry.

A Faculty of Arts sophomore at Chihaya University; Kazuki is bullish and unyielding. As soon as she heard about the film [url=/c11811]Haruto[/url] is making, she was determined to work hard on it until it is finished and scolded Haruto and his friends for being lazy to try finishing it. 
Kazuki is easily moved to tears, for example, when watching impressive and dramatic movies she can cry her eyes out...

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/5/chara.html]the official site[/url].]
